svc_detailed_engineering.title: Projects Construction
svc_detailed_engineering.summary: Reliable Construction Services for Complex Projects
svc_detailed_engineering.description:
As your trusted partner and advocate, we draw on our network of local and global resources, while applying practical know-how to ensure your project is successfully managed from concept to completion and turnover.

We have successfully realized some of the world’s most iconic structures and developments for clients that include public and private developers, companies, and institutions.

From site preparation and civil works to structural construction, MEP installation, finishing works, and project handover, we manage every stage of construction using internationally recognized quality standards and proven construction methodologies.

Our commitment to collaboration, planning, and technical excellence enables us to successfully deliver projects that meet client expectations while supporting long-term operational performance.
svc_detailed_engineering.capabilities: WATERX, ROADS, BRIDGES, DAMS, PORTS, POWER PLANTS, ENERGY

svc_procurement_expediting.title: Procurement & Supply Chain
svc_procurement_expediting.summary: Reliable Procurement Solutions for Efficient Project Delivery
svc_procurement_expediting.description:
Infra Construction provides strategic procurement and supply chain management services that ensure timely material availability, cost efficiency, and operational continuity.

Efficient procurement and reliable supply chain management are essential to successful project delivery. Infra Construction provides integrated procurement solutions that ensure materials, equipment, and services are sourced efficiently while maintaining quality, compliance, and cost control.

Our procurement specialists work closely with trusted suppliers and logistics partners to support infrastructure and industrial projects across multiple sectors. Through strategic sourcing, supplier evaluation, and effective logistics coordination, we help clients reduce procurement risks and maintain uninterrupted project progress.

Our supply chain strategies are designed to improve operational efficiency while supporting project schedules and long-term business objectives.

svc_construction_services.title: Value Engineering & Cost Management
svc_construction_services.summary: Optimizing Project Value Throughout the Project Lifecycle
svc_construction_services.description:
Infra Construction provides value engineering and cost management services that improve project efficiency, optimize budgets, and support sustainable project delivery.

Effective project delivery requires balancing performance, quality, and cost. Infra Construction provides value engineering and cost management services that help clients optimize project resources while maintaining technical integrity and operational performance.

Our specialists evaluate engineering solutions, construction methodologies, procurement strategies, and lifecycle costs to identify opportunities for improved efficiency and measurable cost savings. Through detailed financial planning and engineering analysis, we help clients make informed decisions that reduce waste, enhance project value, and support long-term operational sustainability.

By integrating value engineering early in the project lifecycle, we contribute to better budget control, improved resource utilization, and greater confidence throughout project execution.
svc_construction_services.capabilities:
Value Engineering Studies
Cost Planning & Budget Development
Cost Estimation & Quantity Surveying
Lifecycle Cost Analysis
Cost Control & Financial Monitoring
Procurement Cost Optimization
Risk & Contingency Planning
Project Cost Reporting

svc_construction_management.title: Engineering & Detailed Construction Designs
svc_construction_management.summary: Transforming Concepts into Buildable Engineering Solutions
svc_construction_management.description:
We collaborate with client counterparts to design complex projects that may include engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, maintenance and project management (EPCM). From the earliest stages of project design, we involve the construction and commissioning teams to provide capital cost and schedule efficiency.

Every successful project begins with a clear engineering vision and technically coordinated design. At Infra Construction (IC), we deliver comprehensive engineering and detailed construction design services that convert project concepts into practical, efficient, and fully executable solutions.
Our multidisciplinary engineering teams develop architectural, structural, civil, infrastructure, and MEP designs that comply with international engineering standards while meeting local regulatory requirements. By integrating advanced engineering practices, Building Information Modeling (BIM), and collaborative design processes, we help clients improve constructability, reduce project risks, and optimize long-term asset performance.

From concept development through detailed construction documentation, our focus is on delivering engineering solutions that support quality construction, efficient execution, and sustainable infrastructure development.
svc_construction_management.capabilities:
Architectural & Master Planning Design
Structural Engineering, Civil & Infrastructure Design
Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing (MEP) Engineering
Detailed Construction Drawings 
Shop Drawings & Technical Documentation
BIM Coordination & Clash Detection 
Design Review & Engineering Optimization
Sustainable & Energy-Efficient Design Solutions

svc_facilities_management.title: Projects Construction Management
svc_facilities_management.summary: Integrated Leadership for Successful Project Delivery

We are uniquely positioned to leverage our extensive experience to deliver comprehensive project management services. 

Successful construction projects require effective planning, coordination, and continuous oversight. Infra Construction provides integrated construction management services that ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with established quality, cost, and schedule objectives. 

Our project management professionals coordinate contractors, consultants, suppliers, and stakeholders while monitoring project progress, managing risks, and maintaining transparent communication throughout every project phase. 

Using internationally recognized project management practices and advanced reporting systems, we help clients maintain control, improve decision-making, and achieve successful project outcomes.

svc_operation_maintenance.title: Facilities Management
svc_operation_maintenance.description:
We are uniquely positioned to leverage our extensive experience to deliver comprehensive Facilities management services.

Maintaining the performance of buildings and infrastructure requires a structured approach to operations and maintenance. Infra Construction provides integrated facilities management services that help organizations maximize asset value while ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operations.

about_intro.title: Two Decades of Infrastructure Excellence
about_intro.p1: INFRA Construction was established in 1990 with a clear mission: to deliver complex infrastructure and construction projects to international standards in markets where excellence is most needed. From a specialist contractor serving the Middle East, INFRA has grown into a multi-sector, multi-regional construction group operating across the UAE, Egypt, Yemen, Jordan, Canada, and East Africa.
about_intro.p2: Today, INFRA Construction operates as a member of HS Group — delivering projects across Buildings & Architecture, Infrastructure & Civil Works, Water & Utilities, Energy & Power, Industrial & Oil Services, Engineering & EPC, and Facilities Management. Our integrated capabilities allow us to serve as a single trusted partner from project inception through long-term operations.
about_intro.p3: Backed by ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, certifications, our commitment to quality, safety, and environmental responsibility is embedded in every project we undertake.

about_quote.text: Engineering integrity, safety, and on-time delivery are non-negotiable. We invest in people, plant, and partnerships that compound over years.
about_quote.author: INFRA Construction — Operating Philosophy

about_foundation.title: Built on Engineering Discipline
about_foundation.p1: INFRA Construction was established in 1990 as a specialist contracting company, with the goal of delivering complex infrastructure work to international standards. The company's foundation rests on engineering discipline, operational integrity, and a commitment to delivering every project safely, on time, and to specification.
about_foundation.p2: Over more than two decades, INFRA has expanded its capabilities, its geographic reach, and its sector coverage — evolving from a regional contractor into a multi-disciplinary construction group with a presence across the Middle East, Africa, and Canada.
about_foundation.p3: INFRA is a member of HS Group, which provides the group-level strategic direction, financial backing, and executive leadership that enables INFRA to compete for and deliver major programmes across international markets.

about_future.title: Our Vision for the Future
about_future.p1: INFRA Construction continues to expand its geographic reach, deepen its sector capabilities, and strengthen its partnerships across the Middle East, Africa, and beyond. Our strategic priorities include growing our presence in East Africa, expanding our engineering and EPC capabilities, and investing in digital project delivery technologies.
about_future.p2: We remain committed to our core values: engineering excellence, operational safety, client partnership, and long-term value creation for every stakeholder we work with.

project_1.title: Al-Attiyat Al-Bahariya Wastewater Treatment Plant
project_1.description: Excavation, backfilling and earthworks for the Hayah Kareema wastewater treatment plant at Abnoub, Egypt.
project_1.principalContractor: The Arab Contractors – Osman Ahmed Osman & Co.
project_1.scope: Extensive excavation and backfilling operations, supply and backfilling of clean replacement soil, construction of cement block structures, mechanical excavation for foundation works, and feeding the concrete mixer with sand and gravel.
project_1.p1: Excavation works accounted for USD 308,674 of the contract, with a further USD 9,583 for feeding the concrete mixer with sand and gravel.
project_1.p2: A diverse scope and extensive earthworks under varying ground conditions, delivered to a tight schedule.
project_1.p3: Equipment and manual labour were used for layered backfilling, with mechanical excavation for the foundation works.

project_2.title: Bani Mazar Bridge
project_2.description: Supply and placement of clean fill and subgrade maintenance for the Bani Mazar bridge crossing in Egypt.
project_2.client: GARB – General Authority for Roads, Bridges & Land Transport
project_2.principalContractor: The Arab Contractors – Osman Ahmed Osman & Co.
project_2.scope: Supply and operation of clean dirt, and maintenance of the subgrade.
project_2.p1: Supply and operation of clean dirt accounted for USD 997,498 of the contract, with USD 37,500 for maintenance of the subgrade.
project_2.p2: The scale of the works and a tight programme were the principal challenges.

project_3.title: Bassra Wastewater Treatment Plant
project_3.description: Excavation, backfilling and site preparation for the Hayah Kareema wastewater treatment plant at Bassra, Egypt.
project_3.principalContractor: The Arab Contractors – Osman Ahmed Osman & Co.
project_3.scope: Extensive excavation and backfilling operations, supply and backfilling of clean replacement soil, and mechanical excavation for foundation works.
project_3.p1: Excavation and backfilling works accounted for USD 236,593, mechanical excavation USD 17,000, and site cleaning USD 68,000.
project_3.p2: A diverse scope and extensive earthworks under varying ground conditions, delivered to a tight schedule.
project_3.p3: Equipment and manual labour were used for layered backfilling, with mechanical excavation for the foundation works.

project_5.title: Berbera International Airport — Terminal Refurbishment
project_5.description: Complete rehabilitation of Berbera International Airport — passenger terminal, control tower, security fencing and supporting infrastructure.
project_5.scope: Complete rehabilitation of the airport: maintenance of the passenger terminal and related facilities, interior and exterior finishing works, IT surveillance, service halls, support services and sound systems, the control tower building, GSE facilities, GRP tank assembly, and perimeter chain-link fencing. The contract also covered road construction, building construction, the main entrance gate and fencing, to return the airport to full operational performance.
project_5.p1: Recorded cost components include civil works (USD 269,181), MEP works (USD 121,098), internal and external security fencing (USD 310,350 and USD 220,509), the driveway (USD 53,656), the control tower (USD 38,246), the old cargo building (USD 12,486), GSE sheds (USD 9,439), a water filtration system (USD 21,000), firefighting works (USD 19,957), and mobilisation and demolition (USD 40,000).
project_5.p2: The airport spans more than 4 km², so the works ran across multiple stages and locations. Restricted-area security clearance and permits were required throughout, and the design and scope were incomplete at project start, with additional works arising during delivery.
project_5.p3: Refurbishment, maintenance and replacement works were delivered with local labour supported by a staff of engineers and technicians.
project_5.h4: Security fencing: 18,500 m internal, 2,700 m external
project_5.h5: Control tower maintenance at 10.3 m height; main gate 7.3 m wide × 7.5 m high
project_5.h6: GRP tank installation: 108 m³; water filtration rated for 200 people per day

project_8.title: Design and Build of Hadibu Modern Slaughterhouse
project_8.description: Design and construction of a modern slaughterhouse for Hadibu city, Socotra, complete with cold store, hygiene systems, paved yards and a solar power supply network.
project_8.client: H.H. Sheikh Mansour Bin Zayed Al Nahyan's Engineering Office
project_8.scope: Built environment: design and construction of a modern slaughterhouse for Hadibu city, Socotra; supply, installation and commissioning of a cold store; supply, installation and commissioning of modern facilities and equipment; dedicated spaces for bleeding, skinning and meat dispatch; and an external outer wall. Roads: paving of yards, including parking lots. Power: solar power supply network.
project_8.p1: Hygiene systems (MEP): installations that prevent contact between meat and the floors, walls and fixtures; sufficient slaughter lines to avoid cross-contamination; tool-disinfection facilities supplying hot water at no less than 82°C; handwashing stations to stop staff transferring contamination to meat; and separate lockable storage for meat declared unfit for human consumption.
project_8.p2: The contract value breaks down as USD 373,359 for the built environment — the construction cost of the slaughterhouse including the required equipment installation — USD 105,471 for the solar power supply network, and USD 21,170 for the parking lots and outdoor yards.
project_8.p3: Doors and windows were made of airtight, non-deforming, non-permeable, anti-corrosion materials. Stairs, handrails and railings were built as integral units with an impermeable surface layer, for easy cleaning and disinfection.

project_9.title: Assiut University Buildings
project_9.description: Structural and building works across the Emergency Centre, Dentistry College and Oncology Institute at Assiut University, Egypt.
project_9.scope: Emergency Centre: basement plus eight floors. Dentistry College: basement plus four typical floors. Oncology Institute (Heart Centre and annexes): construction of the final floor.
project_9.p1: The works were carried out at El Fateh, Assiut Governorate. Building works accounted for USD 36,998.70 of the contract.
project_9.p2: Maximum safety considerations were required throughout, with the works carried out in a fully operational environment.
project_9.p3: Delivered using equipment and manual labour for the building works.
project_9.h1: 8,000 m³ of supply and building works

project_10.title: West Assiut Plateau Road

project_10.p2: The scale of the project was the principal challenge.
project_10.p3: Delivered using a combination of equipment, manual and mechanical works.

project_13.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Building — Aden

project_17.title: Private Residential Complex
project_17.description: RESIDENTIAL VILLAS COMPOUND, NAD ALSHEBA, DUBAI
project_17.scope: The complexities came from several factors. First, Dubai's strict regulations required careful compliance, leading to numerous modications throughout the project. Additionally, there was a shortage of subcontractors, which posed challenges in maintaining the project timeline. The client also requested that the swimming pool be positioned very close to the buildings, necessitating a conceptual redesign to accommodate this requirement. Despite these challenges, we successfully navigated the regulatory and logistical hurdles to complete the project.
project_17.p1: Construction of a Villa compound, comprising of 4 Villas on two attached plots of land.
project_17.p2: Pavement of areas within the compound and parkings.
project_17.p3: Providing electrical and mechanical systems for the villa including all the lighting, plumbing, HVAC, and sanitary works.
project_17.h1: The two plots of land equal 1805.96 m2.
project_17.h2: Each plot has 2 villas with a total built up area of 1129.29 m2

news_7.title: We are pleased to announce the start of construction works for the Al Wathba Slaughterhouse Cold Storage Expansion Project in Abu Dhabi
news_7.excerpt: We are pleased to announce the start of construction works for the Al Wathba Slaughterhouse Cold Storage Expansion Project in Abu Dhabi, delivered by Infra Construction in partnership with STBM for the Abu Dhabi Municipality.
news_7.author: INFRA Communications
news_7.p1:
We are pleased to announce the start of construction works for the Al Wathba Slaughterhouse Cold Storage Expansion Project in Abu Dhabi, delivered by Infra Construction in partnership with STBM for the Abu Dhabi Municipality.
The project marks another step toward enhancing service facilities and strengthening infrastructure that supports the food security ecosystem in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.
news_7.p2:
Our technical teams have officially commenced on-site activities, including site preparation, safety setup, excavation, and initial groundwork, paving the way for the next phases of construction in line with the approved project schedule.
The scope of the project includes the construction of new steel structure buildings, featuring the following: Expansion of the existing meat cold storage facility. Expansion of the ticketing area and public hall. Development of a new dedicated meat cooling zone.
news_7.p3: These upgrades form part of an integrated development plan aimed at improving operational efficiency and enhancing the overall functionality of the facility.
news_7.p4:
The project is scheduled to be completed within six months, with execution carried out according to the highest engineering and construction standards to ensure quality, reliability, and operational performance.
At Infra Construction, we remain committed to contributing to the development of vital infrastructure projects in Abu Dhabi and delivering construction solutions that create long-term value and support sustainable development.

news_8.title: Infra Construction and SAK Construction Explore Strategic Partnership in Kuwait
news_8.excerpt: Infra Construction held a high-level meeting with SAK Construction in Kuwait to explore collaboration on major infrastructure projects financed by the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development.
news_8.author: INFRA Communications
news_8.p1: As part of its strategy to expand across the GCC and strengthen its regional presence, Infra Construction conducted a strategic business visit to the State of Kuwait, where the team held a high-level meeting with SAK Construction to explore opportunities for future collaboration.
news_8.p2: The discussions focused on developing strategic partnerships for the delivery of major development and infrastructure projects, particularly those financed by the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development (KFAED). The meeting highlighted the shared commitment of both organizations to supporting impactful infrastructure initiatives that contribute to sustainable economic growth across the region.
news_8.p3: This visit reflects Infra Construction's ongoing commitment to building long-term partnerships with leading local organizations and expanding its presence in key regional markets. By collaborating with trusted industry leaders, the company continues to strengthen its ability to deliver integrated engineering and construction solutions that meet the evolving needs of governments, development institutions, and private sector clients.
news_8.p4: As Infra Construction continues its regional growth journey, strategic collaborations such as this reinforce its vision of creating lasting value through innovation, technical excellence, and sustainable infrastructure development.

news_9.title: Union of the Comoros Hospital Tender
news_9.excerpt: Infra Construction has submitted a bid for a major infrastructure tender in the Union of the Comoros to rehabilitate and construct three hospitals, reinforcing its regional expansion strategy.
news_9.author: INFRA Communications
news_9.p1: As part of its regional expansion strategy and commitment to strengthening its presence across emerging markets, Infra Construction has submitted a bid for a major infrastructure tender in the Union of the Comoros, involving the rehabilitation and construction of three hospitals.
news_9.p2: The project forms part of the country's ongoing efforts to enhance healthcare infrastructure, improve access to quality medical services, and deliver modern healthcare facilities that better serve local communities.
news_9.p3: Infra Construction's participation is backed by its extensive regional expertise and strong local presence through the Group's consulting office in the Union of the Comoros, which continuously monitors market developments and supports the identification and evaluation of strategic project opportunities.
news_9.p4: According to the Group's local consulting office, Infra Construction's proposal ranked among the competitive bids submitted for the tender, highlighting the company's strong technical capabilities, competitive financial offering, and ability to successfully deliver large-scale development projects across the region.
news_9.p5: This milestone reflects Infra Construction's continued commitment to delivering sustainable infrastructure solutions and engineering excellence, contributing to national development priorities while creating long-term value in the markets where it operates.

news_10.title: Infra Construction and SAK Construction Explore Strategic Partnership in Kuwait
news_10.excerpt: Infra Construction held a high-level meeting with SAK Construction in Kuwait to explore collaboration on major infrastructure projects financed by the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development.
news_10.p1: As part of its strategy to expand across the GCC and strengthen its regional presence, Infra Construction conducted a strategic business visit to the State of Kuwait, where the team held a high-level meeting with SAK Construction to explore opportunities for future collaboration.
news_10.p2: The discussions focused on developing strategic partnerships for the delivery of major development and infrastructure projects, particularly those financed by the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development (KFAED). The meeting highlighted the shared commitment of both organizations to supporting impactful infrastructure initiatives that contribute to sustainable economic growth across the region.
news_10.p3: This visit reflects Infra Construction's ongoing commitment to building long-term partnerships with leading local organizations and expanding its presence in key regional markets. By collaborating with trusted industry leaders, the company continues to strengthen its ability to deliver integrated engineering and construction solutions that meet the evolving needs of governments, development institutions, and private sector clients.
news_10.p4: As Infra Construction continues its regional growth journey, strategic collaborations such as this reinforce its vision of creating lasting value through innovation, technical excellence, and sustainable infrastructure development.

news_11.title: Infra Construction Invited to Tender for ADNOC-Supervised Project in Habshan
news_11.excerpt: Infra Construction has been invited by Petrojet – UAE Branch to participate in a tender for civil and finishing works on several buildings in Habshan, Abu Dhabi, under ADNOC supervision.
news_11.p1: Reflecting the growing confidence in its expertise and execution capabilities, Infra Construction has been invited to participate in a tender issued by Petrojet – UAE Branch, one of Egypt's leading petroleum sector companies, for a project under the supervision of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC).
news_11.p2: The tender covers the execution of civil works, as well as internal and external finishing works, for several buildings located in the Habshan area of Abu Dhabi.
news_11.p3: The scope contributes directly to the development of the project's infrastructure, delivered in line with the highest engineering and construction standards applied across the region's energy sector.
news_11.p4: This invitation marks another milestone in Infra Construction's regional expansion strategy, reinforcing its presence across key markets through the delivery of high-value projects in collaboration with some of the region's most prominent organizations.
news_11.author: Infra Construction

news_12.title: Construction Progress Continues at Al Wathba Slaughterhouse Expansion Project
news_12.excerpt: Steady progress continues on the Al Wathba Slaughterhouse Meat Chillers Expansion Project, with the structural steel framework complete and concrete floor casting next.
news_12.p1: Infra Construction continues to make steady progress on the Al Wathba Slaughterhouse Meat Chillers Expansion Project, a strategic development aimed at increasing the facility's storage capacity to meet the growing demands of commercial slaughter operations while enhancing operational efficiency in line with the highest industry standards.
news_12.p2: The project has successfully completed the structural steel framework, with preparations currently underway for the concrete floor casting.
news_12.p3: The next phase will include masonry works alongside the commencement of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) installations, all progressing according to the approved project schedule.
news_12.p4: This milestone reflects Infra Construction's commitment to delivering high-quality engineering and construction solutions, maintaining strict adherence to project timelines, and contributing to the development of resilient infrastructure that supports the UAE's growing food and industrial sectors.
news_12.author: Infra Construction

news_14.title: Competing for AfDB-Funded Road Reinforcement and Drainage Works on Djibouti's RN2
news_14.excerpt: Infra Construction is bidding for an African Development Bank–funded tender covering reinforcement and drainage improvements along 15.4 km of National Road RN2 in Djibouti.
news_14.p1: A new project on the road, and strong competition for a key infrastructure opportunity. Infra Construction is competing for an African Development Bank (AfDB)-funded tender for reinforcement works and drainage system improvements along National Road RN2 in Djibouti, covering a 15.4 km section from the Nagad Junction to Loyada.
news_14.p2: The project represents an important opportunity to contribute to the development of Djibouti's road and infrastructure network, improve road performance, enhance drainage capacity, and strengthen the long-term protection and resilience of the road infrastructure.
news_14.p3: Infra Construction has initiated the preparation of its bid through several of its regional offices, in preparation for the submission of both the technical and financial proposals in French on 19 August.
news_14.p4: The competition has begun, and preparation is the key to winning.
news_14.author: Infra Construction

news_13.title: Infra Construction Invited to DBOT Tender for Sustainable Amman Slaughterhouse Project
news_13.excerpt: Infra Construction, in consortium with STBM, has been invited to the Design, Build, Operate, Transfer tender for the Sustainable Amman Slaughterhouse Project in Jordan.
news_13.p1: Strengthening our presence in strategic infrastructure projects, Infra Construction has been invited to participate in the Design, Build, Operate, Transfer (DBOT) tender for the Sustainable Amman Slaughterhouse Project, developed by the Greater Amman Municipality through Amman Vision for Investment and Development.
news_13.p2: The project brings together Infra Construction and STBM, a specialist in the design, construction, and operation of modern slaughterhouses, combining engineering excellence with operational expertise to deliver a fully integrated solution that meets the highest technical and operational standards.
news_13.p3: This strategic consortium also reinforces economic and investment cooperation between the United Arab Emirates and the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, in coordination with the UAE Food Cluster, supporting knowledge exchange and the development of sustainable infrastructure that advances regional food security.
news_13.p4: This opportunity marks another important milestone in Infra Construction's continued expansion in Public-Private Partnership (PPP) projects, reflecting our commitment to delivering resilient infrastructure, creating long-term value, and supporting sustainable economic development across the region.
news_13.author: Infra Construction
